title: Wordbloom: Word Journey
one_line: Swipe letters to fill crossword grids across 8 dreamy worlds, from cherry blossoms to a starfall nebula.
how_to_play: Swipe across the letters in the circle to spell a word, then let go (or type it and press Enter). Words that fit the crossword grid fly into place; fill every square to clear the level. Real words that are not in the grid are bonus words: ten fill the jar for 30 coins. Find words quickly for a combo. Stuck? Shuffle is free, Hint shows a letter, Spark shows the square you tap, Bloom shows 5 letters. Clear a level with no hints for 3 stars.
description: A relaxing, clever word puzzle journey. Spell words from a ring of letters to fill a crossword grid, then travel on through 8 animated worlds: Blossom Valley, Golden Dunes, Coral Lagoon, Lantern Harbor, Aurora Fjord, Jade Peaks, Firefly Forest and Starfall Nebula. 200 hand-checked levels grow from 3-letter warmups to 7-letter brain teasers. Catch bonus words for coins, chain quick finds into combos, earn up to 3 stars per level, and keep your streak alive with a new Daily Puzzle every day.
